additional_info.subject: RE: ID0397925-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R7 313065117104] Blackscreen problem CRM:00641000933
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Yunus,
I hope this message finds you well.
To assist with troubleshooting the HMI blackout issue, I kindly recommend collecting the required images or videos of the black screen, if possible, as they will be helpful for record-keeping and further analysis.
Based on this, I suggest planning a site intervention to inspect the connections thoroughly. It is essential to check for any loose connections between KF1 and PH2. Additionally, please ensure that the DPP and USB connections used for the OC display and touch functionality are properly inspected.
There is also a possibility that the DPP or USB cable may be faulty. I recommend swapping them with working cables to confirm. If the issue persists after these checks, replacing the screen may be necessary.
During the site visit, please bring the following spare parts to facilitate on-site resolution if needed:
HMI
DPP cable
USB cable
Kindly refer to the marked HMI schematic provided below and review the attached Q-feedback document for detailed troubleshooting guidance.
https://support.industry.siemens.com/cs/document/109816666/si-e-q-feedback-q2302-sicharge-d-hmi-backlight-off-and-scrambled-image-due-to-router-emissions?dti=0&lc=en-WW
Please note, if the charger's DLogic is Gen2, then Q-feedback process will not apply.
For that we need to check the above connection.
For your reference, kindly review the part below,
Controlpanel DLogic Gen2-: 8EM5903-0AA04-0AA0
please ensure once with existing one before ordered
Note-: When ordering spare parts, please consider the type of existing control panel to ensure compatibility with the new HMI.
If you require any further assistance or clarification, please do not hesitate to reach out to us.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Abhinav Malokar
